children: On 17 November 2026, Eltel welcomes investors, analysts and financial media to an afternoon focused on how the company’s transformation has strengthened profitability and generated growth in new business areas – and how Eltel is now well positioned for future growth.

The Capital Markets Day will be held at Inderes Studio, Västra Trädgårdsgatan 19, Stockholm. Participants may also join online. The event starts at 13:00 and is expected to end at approximately 17:00.
Register for in-person or online participation at: https://eltel.events.inderes.com/cmd-2026
The program will provide an in-depth view of the market outlook, competitive position and value creation across the company’s markets. President and CEO

will open the event by reflecting on Eltel’s transformation journey over the past three years. He will share how strong strategic execution has strengthened profitability, unlocked growth opportunities in new business areas, and created a solid platform for the company’s next phase of sustainable, profitable growth. Eltel’s CFO,

, will then provide a financial review, followed by perspectives from the Managing Directors of each Nordic country on how Eltel continues to drive growth and strengthen profitability on the Nordic markets. We will also take a closer look at selected areas through customer cases and projects illustrating how the strategy is being put into practice in solar energy, data center solutions and public infrastructure.

The day will conclude with a Q&A session with Group Management, with questions welcomed both in person and via the webcast. In-person attendees are also invited to stay for networking, drinks and light refreshments.
The presentations and Q&A session will be held in English. Presentation materials and a recording of the Capital Markets Day will be made available afterwards at: https://www.eltelgroup.com/

Eltel is one of the leading service providers for critical infrastructure in the Nordics. Our 3,800 colleagues across the Nordics, Germany and Lithuania enable the digitalization and electrification of society by providing services and turnkey solutions for high performing communication and power networks and renewable energy. The head office is located in Sweden and Eltel's shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. In 2025 the total net sales amounted to EUR 817.8 million. Read more at www.eltelnetworks.com.
